## Methods

### Data Sources

Data files are stored in the `data/raw/` directory. The analysis uses R version `r getRversion()` for all statistical computations.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Function to safely load packages
load_package <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    message(paste("Package", pkg, "not found. Please install with: install.packages('", pkg, "')", sep = ""))
    return(FALSE)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  return(TRUE)
}

# Load required libraries
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "knitr", "here")
recommended_packages <- c("janitor")
optional_packages <- c("kableExtra", "DT", "gt")

# Load required packages
missing_required <- c()
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!load_package(pkg)) {
    missing_required <- c(missing_required, pkg)
  }
}

if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Required packages missing:", paste(missing_required, collapse=", "), 
             "\nPlease run: make install-r-packages"))
}

# Load recommended packages (warn if missing)
for (pkg in recommended_packages) {
  if (!load_package(pkg)) {
    message(paste("Recommended package", pkg, "not found. Install with: install.packages('", pkg, "')", sep=""))
  }
}

# Load optional packages (silent if missing)
kable_extra_available <- load_package("kableExtra")
dt_available <- load_package("DT")
gt_available <- load_package("gt")

# Set global options
options(scipen = 999)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = "output/figures/",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Source analysis functions if they exist (with error handling)
source_if_exists <- function(file) {
  if (file.exists(file)) {
    tryCatch({
      source(file)
      message(paste("Loaded:", file))
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Warning: Could not source", file, "- Error:", e$message))
    })
  }
}

source_if_exists("R/01_data_import.R")
source_if_exists("R/02_data_cleaning.R")
source_if_exists("R/03_analysis.R")
source_if_exists("R/04_visualization.R")
```
